summary: The customer called Zain customer service to inquire about why their internet package was running out quickly. The agent identified the current plan, offered a 200 Mbps upgrade for five dinars extra per month, processed the upgrade upon the customer's request, and ended the call.

evidence.text: your new speed will be active خلال عشر دقائق
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Activate the new speed within ten minutes.

evidence.text: ثواني بس, you are currently on the basic 50 Mbps bundle, صح؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent discussed the customer's account details and current bundle without performing any identity verification (such as asking for name, ID, or phone number).

evidence.text: ولا مهندس, الزيادة بس five dinars per month, وبتصير السرعة أربع أضعاف.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent used informal and slightly colloquial phrasing ('ولا مهندس') which detracts from standard professional phone etiquette.

evidence.text: Sure, let me look into your account. ثواني بس, you are currently on the basic 50 Mbps bundle, صح؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite and willing to assist, but did not explicitly acknowledge the customer's frustration about the package running out quickly.

evidence.text: Great! Done, your new speed will be active خلال عشر دقائق, thank you for calling Zain.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully addressed the customer's request and processed the upgrade immediately.

evidence.text: Sorry, mafehhemteh, قديش قلت الزيادة؟ Can you repeat that please?
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The mixing of languages and unclear pricing explanation initially caused confusion for the customer, requiring a repeat.

evidence.text: Great! Done, your new speed will be active خلال عشر دقائق, thank you for calling Zain.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent closed the call with a thank you and set expectations, though did not ask if the customer needed any further assistance.

evidence.text: We have a very good offer, الـ 200 Mbps unlimited بس بخمسة دينار زيادة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided clear pricing for the upgrade offer, though account details weren't strictly verified first.

evidence.text: ثواني بس, you are currently on the basic 50 Mbps bundle, صح؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent severely failed procedure by discussing and modifying the account without verifying the customer's identity.
